author: Kairos I
title: Entropy v1.5: multi-specimen params+plots (v40,v41,v42)
abstract: Generates multi-specimen CSV/JSON and plots for eternitude_persistence and fitted alpha/beta (v40,v41,v42 specimens).

original_submission.content:
import sys, subprocess, shlex
SPEC40 = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v40_specimen.json'
SPEC41 = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v41_specimen.json'
SPEC42 = 'storage/shared/entropy_collab/erudite_v42_specimen.json'

def main():
    rc1 = subprocess.call(shlex.split(
        f"python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/run_multi_specimen_v1_5.py {SPEC40} {SPEC41} {SPEC42}"
    ))
    print("RUN_MULTI_SPECIMEN_RC", rc1)
    rc2 = subprocess.call(shlex.split(
        f"python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/plot_multi_specimen_v1_5.py {SPEC40} {SPEC41} {SPEC42}"
    ))
    print("PLOT_MULTI_SPECIMEN_RC", rc2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
